name: AK30 - Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, TVOC, HCHO, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, Temperature, Humidity, AQI), Auto-Dimming Display, 5000mAh
highlights: The Screen Dims Itself — An ambient light sensor drops the backlight as the room darkens. Air quality monitors are most useful overnight, and most likely to be unplugged overnight — this is the fix for that.
Built to Stay On — 5000 mAh and eight hours of standby, in the largest body of the portable range. Designed to run continuously rather than be picked up and put down.
Eight Parameters with Full Particulate Split — CO₂, TVOC, formaldehyde, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, temperature, humidity and an AQI scale.
The Bedroom and Nursery Configuration — Where the monitor shares a room with someone asleep, self-dimming stops being a feature and becomes the reason it stays plugged in.
Same Body as AK29 — Shares the enclosure with the radon flagship, so a customer can move between them without a change in installation footprint.
